name: Phase Gate Guard
summary: Block phase evidence writes unless the previous phase in the spec-design-tasks-implementation chain exists and is valid.
description: Guard the reserved .youdede/phases/ evidence directory so a phase advances only when its predecessor's evidence file exists, parses, and carries a matching phase, a real summary, and non-empty anchors. Unknown filenames, malformed evidence, and unsafe predecessors are blocked.
risk_reason: This automatic gate blocks phase evidence writes unless the previous phase in the spec-design-tasks-implementation chain exists and is valid; a false denial can interrupt legitimate work, but it does not execute the blocked action.
refuses: It does not judge the quality of any phase document; it verifies only the predecessor chain's presence and validity.
It does not inspect, block, or observe writes outside the reserved .youdede/phases/ directory.
It does not execute submitted content, call an LLM, download dependencies, or transmit inspected data.
It does not treat an unreadable, symlinked, or oversized predecessor file as valid evidence.

entrypoints.purpose: Evaluate Write and Edit calls against the reserved phase-evidence directory and block invalid phase advancement.

operational.latency_reason: The entrypoint handles one intercepted event to block phase evidence writes unless the previous phase in the spec-design-tasks-implementation chain exists and is valid without deferred work.
